claim.raw_value: For purposes of this agreement, a “willful and material breach” means a material breach of, or a material failure to perform, any representation, warranty or covenant set forth in this Agreement, in each case that is the consequence of an intentional act or intentional omission by a party with the actual knowledge that the taking of such act or failure to take such act would result in such material breach of this or material failure to perform.
